title: Japanese Chicken Skewers
description: Grilled Japanese-style chicken skewers, marinated in a mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and chili flakes. Perfect for a quick and delicious meal.
instructions: Marinate the chicken in a mixture of soy sauce, garlic, and chili flakes for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated chicken onto the skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Brush the skewers with sesame oil and season with salt.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Brush the skewers with honey during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
Garnish with chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve with steamed vegetables or rice for a complete meal.
